`raygui.h` is the unmodified header from [raygui 5.0](https://github.com/raysan5/raygui/tree/5.0).

- Tag commit: `020a61bebcbe288b4414de3416e219ef40af847a`
- Source: <https://github.com/raysan5/raygui/blob/5.0/src/raygui.h>

After deliberately updating the header, regenerate the Lisp declarations with
`python3 tools/generate-bindings.py`, review API changes, and run the tests.
